citation.license: Use and redistribution are subject to the IMF's data-usage terms, including attribution and downstream-user conditions; commercial reuse may require IMF permission — consult the IMF terms directly
citation.attribution: Source: International Monetary Fund
citation.citation_text: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook (April 2026), General government gross debt (% of GDP), series GGXWDG_NGDP. Retrieved 2026-07-26 via the IMF DataMapper API/StatCite. https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/GGXWDG_NGDP@WEO/LAO

notes: Primary source is the IMF WEO general government gross debt series; the World Bank WDI series covers central government only and is patchier.

IMF DataMapper serves WEO-database values rounded to one decimal place (Fiscal Monitor-sourced fiscal series are full precision); derived transforms (e.g. year-over-year change) computed from these values can carry up to ±0.1 of additional rounding error.

Values for 2026 onward are IMF WEO estimates/projections, not final outturns. This boundary is a vintage-year heuristic derived from the data's own projection horizon: the IMF's "latest actual" year varies by country and series, so some observations before 2026 may also be IMF staff estimates rather than final outturns.
